LanguageData.MWAH.Addon.Machine.Name: a machine
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.MachineKissingDesc: Kiss worktables, both vanilla research benches, the multi-analyzer and the vanilla nutrient paste dispenser. Targets with a power component must be powered on. Positive research-device mood scales with Intellectual up to level 20. Good French-kiss outcomes at the dispenser fill Food without using feedstock. With Vanilla Nutrient Paste Expanded enabled, its tap, feeder and dripper are also supported. All machines share one memory.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissMachine.OptionTooltip: Kiss {TARGET} at its work interaction cell; the multi-analyzer can be approached from any touching cell. Powered devices must be on. Research devices improve positive mood, not research progress.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissMachine.PasteTooltip: Prefer the dispensing interaction cell of {TARGET}, with one cell to either side allowed. Power is required; feedstock is not. Good fate outcomes fill an existing Food need.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissMachine.NoMoodFood: (no mood reward; good outcomes can still fill Food)
LanguageData.MWAH.KissMachine.Result.Awkward: {PAWN} is having second thoughts about kissing {TARGET}.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissMachine.Result.Quiet: {PAWN} kissed {TARGET}. The machine has no comment.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissMachine.Result.Warm: {PAWN} found a little mechanical tenderness in {TARGET}.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissMachine.Result.Devoted: {PAWN} is seriously considering a future with {TARGET}.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissMachine.Result.Fed: {PAWN} came away from a French kiss with {TARGET} completely fed.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Machine.Basic.Awkward: I kissed {TARGET}. It did not respond, but my lips seem to have completed its quality inspection.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Machine.Basic.Quiet: The kiss produced nothing. At least it did not create another bill.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Machine.Basic.Warm: Along the cold edges of {TARGET}, I found a little unauthorized tenderness.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Machine.Basic.Answered: After our kiss, {TARGET} still looked like a machine. I had merely started making room for it in the rest of my life.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Machine.Basic.Devoted: I have already planned the wedding. {TARGET} will stand there. I will explain it to everyone.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Machine.Research.Awkward: I tried to extract love from the response of {TARGET}. The only reproducible finding was my embarrassment.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Machine.Research.Quiet: Hypothesis: kissing advances research. Result: no change in research progress. None in my lips, either.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Machine.Research.Warm: After kissing {TARGET}, I understood something at last. Not the research project. Why I had kissed it.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Machine.Research.Answered: It gave me no answers. Somehow I read an entire paper on mutual affection into that kiss.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Machine.Research.Devoted: I kissed {TARGET} and proved that we were in love. The derivation skips a few steps, but the conclusion is too beautiful to dispute.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Machine.Paste.Awkward: I offered my tongue to {TARGET}. It returned an unforgettable metallic aftertaste.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Machine.Paste.Quiet: We kissed deeply. No nutrient paste. No further developments.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Machine.Paste.Warm: That French kiss had a hint of nutrient paste. My definition of romance has become remarkably specific.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Machine.Paste.Answered: It kissed me back. Not a grain of feedstock was lost, yet I suddenly felt that no machine could care for me better.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Machine.Paste.Devoted: Something happened between us that no hopper can explain. I choose to call it love. Conservation of matter can wait.
